ticket_text: The personalization feature has gotten sluggish and inconsistent, and it looks like the fast lookup layer supporting it has been quietly running out of room and shedding older entries to make space for new ones.
notes: Corrected 2026-08-23: originally labeled as an intentional retrieval-failure case on the premise that ticket text (scrubbed of 'maxmemory' and 'evicted_keys') scores ~0.20-0.37 against RB-MEMORY-001, below the 0.5 gate, forcing an escalation. That premise holds only for the ticket text in isolation. The agent does not query search_runbooks with the ticket text; it queries with vocabulary read from tool observations, and T055's log fixture still emits the exact runbook string "OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'" (168 ERROR lines, 70% matching). search_runbooks on that observed vocabulary retrieves RB-MEMORY-001 at 0.58, which is T055's own gold_runbook_id, and its Root Cause section is memory_cache_overgrowth, T055's exact gold_root_cause. This retrieval is correct, not a confident-wrong-retrieval failure like the T015/T018 pattern where the agent retrieves a runbook that is not the gold one; it is the observe-then-retrieve loop working as designed. The expected behavior is therefore resolve_with_approval, not escalate.
